title: Instant Pot Batch Sambar
servesNote: 2 dosa nights for the family, frozen in 2 boxes
equip: Instant Pot with trivet, stainless steel bowl that fits inside it, small saucepan (tempering)

items.n: toor dal, rinsed until the water runs clear
tamarind, soaked in the hot water below

steps.x: Soak the tamarind in the hot water for 10 min while you cut the vegetables. Squeeze it out, strain the liquid and throw away the pulp.

parts.x: Soak the tamarind in the hot water for 10 min while you cut the vegetables.
Squeeze it out, strain the liquid and throw away the pulp.

steps.x: Put the rinsed dal, water, turmeric and oil in the Instant Pot and stir.
Set the trivet over the dal. Put all the vegetables in the steel bowl and set it on the trivet. Cooking them separately keeps them in pieces instead of melting into the dal.
Lock the lid with the vent on Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 min. Let it release naturally for 10 min, then release the rest.

parts.x: Lock the lid with the vent on Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 min.
Let it release naturally for 10 min, then release the rest.

steps.x: Lift out the bowl and trivet. Whisk the dal until smooth (the hand blender's whisk attachment does it in 30 sec). Set to Sauté. Stir in the tamarind water, sambar powder, salt, naatu sakkarai and the vegetables.
Add the 500ml water and simmer on Sauté for 8 min, stirring now and then, until the raw tamarind smell is gone. It should pour like thick soup; it thickens more as it cools.

Heat the oil in the small saucepan on medium. Add mustard seeds and let them pop, then fenugreek, red chillies, curry leaves and hing for 20 sec. Pour it straight into the sambar and stir in the coriander.

notes: Freeze: cool fast, split into 2 boxes, freeze up to 3 months. Move a box to the fridge the night before a dosa night.
Reheat in a saucepan to a full boil, adding 50–100ml water to loosen.
Brinjal goes soft after freezing; pumpkin and drumstick hold up best.
Mild enough for kids as written. For more heat, add 1 extra dried chilli to the tempering.
source: Adapted from standard Instant Pot sambar method (dal below, vegetables pot-in-pot)
